value.question: What is the role of a principal investigator?
plan: Leads the research team and ensures protocol compliance.
Ensures participant safety and data integrity.

value.draft: The principal investigator leads the research team and ensures the study follows all established protocols. They approve key decisions and actions related to the trial. Their role also includes safeguarding participant safety and maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the data collected throughout the study. The principal investigator is ultimately responsible for the scientific and ethical conduct of the clinical trial.
